description: Jest 30.5.2's v8 provider on modules that start with a hashbang (T8.12, B23b Phase 6 review). `src/greet.js` is plain CommonJS JavaScript ending in `module.exports`, which Jest runs untransformed (the recorder's transform names TypeScript only) and both test files import, so Jest's module function counts 2: Provino's CommonJS wrapper and the vm script around it must count nowhere else, at any worker count. `src/cli.ts` goes through babel-jest with `@babel/preset-typescript` (D123) and ends in an interface. Jest's ScriptTransformer removes a hashbang line's text before the code runs (`stripShebang`) while its v8 report reads the file as it is, so every range of `greet.js` sits one hashbang earlier than its code. The JavaScript module is text in `files` (no `.js` is committed, D13). The `json`, `json-summary` and `text` reports are recorded as Jest wrote them (the work directory as `<root>`). Read by `provino`'s `jest-coverage-v8.test.ts`.
